title: Asking for Help
description: Learn essential Tamil phrases for emergencies — asking for help, calling for police, and getting medical assistance.

exercises.explanation: Emergency phrases — memorize 'kaappathunga' (help me) and 'hospital enga irukku' (where is the hospital).

exercises.question: How do you shout 'help!' in Tamil?
exercises.explanation: 'Kaappathunga!' = help me / save me! This is the word to shout in an emergency.
'Police kuppunga' = call the police (polite imperative). Kuppunga = please call.
'Police kuppunga!' = call the police! In an emergency, even just saying 'police!' loudly gets attention.
'Enakku udavi vendum' = I need help. 'Udavi' = help/assistance. Or simply 'help vendum'.

exercises.question: You get into the wrong auto. How do you say 'stop here'?
exercises.explanation: 'Inge nillunga' = stop here. Nillunga = please stop, inge = here.
'Hospital enga irukku?' — the most important emergency phrase. Pattern: place + enga + irukku.
'Enakku vazhitheriyala' = I don't know the way (I'm lost). Or 'naan tholachuten' = I got lost.
